name: Conservation, Food & Health Foundation grants
summary: Seed grants for applied research, pilot projects and training in conservation, food and health in Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America and the Middle East, with a short concept application twice a year before invited proposals.

geography.label: Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America, and the Middle East

reporting: Grantees submit a final report; multi-year grantees also submit an interim progress report, an interim financial report and a second-year work plan before the end of the first grant period.

calls.label: Yearly window: October 15 to December 22 (year not stated)

status.quote: Submit your online concept application between October 15 and December 22 or between May 1 and June 15.

administered_by.quote: c/o Prentice A. Zinn, Administrator GMA Foundations 2 Liberty Square, Suite 500 Boston, Massachusetts 02109

applicant_types.quote: Most organizations that can provide evidence of their non-governmental status or charitable purpose are eligible to apply, including non-governmental organizations, nonprofit organizations, civil society organizations, community-based organizations, and colleges, universities, and other academic institutions.

geography.quote: The Foundation supports local, state, and regional organizations in Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America, and the Middle East, where the projects are based.

access.quote: The foundation has an online, two-phase application system comprised of a short concept application, followed by a limited number of invited full proposals.

window.quote: The concept application (or LOI) is open two times per year

reporting.quote: Interim progress reports, interim financial reports and second-year work plans for multi-year grants are due 30 days before the end of the recipient's first grant period.
